about: Quanome Technologies, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides cross-border supply chain solutions in the United States, and China. It provides cross-border ocean freight solutions and cross-border airfreight solutions, including cross-border freight consolidation and forwarding, customs clearance, container unloading, warehousing and distribution, unpacking and packing, and ground transportation. It also develops Quantum Nexus, A decision-support platform for evaluating quantum technologies and related risks; and XDT, an AI infrastructure platform for organizations with demanding computing requirements. The company serves therapeutic discovery, healthcare, advanced materials, energy and cybersecurity industries. The company was formerly known as Lakeside Holding Limited and changed its name to Quanome Technologies, Inc. in August 2026. Quanome Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2018 and is base in New York, New York.
